summary:
quality lens over backend-observability (11 product path(s), a40b7a1..6072e0d, Codex via the autoreview skill at --max-priority P2): 0 blocking, 2 non-blocking. VERDICT t9-c1: partial — backend/src/common/global-exception.filter.ts:83 recognizes only a class-validator-shaped message array despite the application using Zod validation
VERDICT t9-c2: partial — backend/src/common/request-logging.middleware.ts:51 permits arbitrary non-email/non-ID path segments into structured log context
VERDICT t9-c3: implemented — backend/src/common/error-envelope.wiring.test.ts:27 exercises configureApp()+app.init(), and both tests are registered in backend/package.json:15 and tools/quality-gate.test.mjs:23

The filter and middleware are reachable before the Swagger early return, structured request/error records share correlation data, and the main console calls were migrated. However, validation errors are not reliably mapped to the required contract and client-controlled path data is insufficiently masked, so the patch is not ready as submitted.

blocking_findings.summary: t9-c1: a global exception filter (constitution 07) maps every unhandled exception and existing HttpException to the full standard error payload (errorId, type, user-facing message, sanitized details, http status, correlationId, requestId, environment, timestampUtc) and is wired app-wide via useGlobalFilters

t9-c2: structured JSON logging (constitution 05 §2.1) emits a request record and, on error, a distinct error record, each carrying timestampUtc/level/message/context/environment/serviceName/module/correlationId/accountId/requestId; correlationId accepts a valid inbound x-correlation-id else generates a UUID at ingress

non_blocking_findings.summary: [P2] Recognize the application's Zod validation failures (backend/src/common/global-exception.filter.ts:83): `validationDetails` only classifies a 400 as validation when `HttpException.getResponse().message` is a `string[]`, which the comment identifies as the class-validator shape.

[P2] Do not log arbitrary unmatched path segments (backend/src/common/request-logging.middleware.ts:51): The masking predicate only redacts emails containing a literal `@`, UUIDs, decimal IDs, and long hexadecimal strings.

contract_verdicts.evidence: backend/src/common/global-exception.filter.ts:83 recognizes only a class-validator-shaped message array despite the application using Zod validation
backend/src/common/request-logging.middleware.ts:51 permits arbitrary non-email/non-ID path segments into structured log context
backend/src/common/error-envelope.wiring.test.ts:27 exercises configureApp()+app.init(), and both tests are registered in backend/package.json:15 and tools/quality-gate.test.mjs:23
